camel_example: aliyun dytnsapi DescribeNumberMccMnc --region cn-hangzhou --AuthCode example --PhoneNumber 86123434345 --version 2023-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the country and carrier (MCC and MNC codes) of an international phone number
description_zh: 号码百科国际站号码归属服务,用于查询号码归属的国家和运营商(Mcc Mnc 码)
name: DescribeNumberMccMnc

parameters.help_en: The phone number. You must include the country code before the phone number. For example, for a phone number in Hong Kong (China), the value is 85212343433
parameters.help_zh: 号码，（号码前需要带上区号）如中国香港地区号码，则为85212343433
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

To obtain the authorization code, log on to the Phone Number Service console, go to the Tag Square (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square) page, select a tag, and submit an application. After the application is approved, you will receive the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在登录号码百科控制台->标签广场 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后，会获得该授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en: The status code of the request. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。 OK为成功

CountryIso3.description_en: The ISO3 code of the country to which the phone number belongs

Mcc.description_en: The MCC code of the carrier to which the phone number belongs

Mnc.description_en: The MNC code of the carrier to which the phone number belongs

Ported.description_en: Indicates whether the phone number has been ported
Ported.description_zh: 号码是否有发生过携转

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
